name: A Level Politics: Ballotwick
subtitle: A Level Politics revision labs
shortDescription: Learn A Level Politics with electoral and bill simulations, essay plans and adaptive quizzes for AQA and Edexcel. Free to start, optional Ballotwick Plus.
longDescription:
Ballotwick is an A Level Politics study app for students following AQA 7152 or Pearson Edexcel 9PL0. Revise the whole course in clear steps, test yourself with quizzes that adapt to you, and learn by changing things in simulations.

### What You Get
- 53 topics across UK government and politics, USA government and politics, comparing the UK and the USA, core and other political ideas, and Edexcel Global Politics.
- 424 original practice questions, at least 8 for every topic, each with an explanation and a link back to the exact part of the lesson.
- Lessons with key terms, cases and thinkers, a "weigh it up" balance of arguments, and an exam tip for every topic.
- Adaptive practice: the app tracks what you know topic by topic, picks your next questions, and sends you back to the right lesson part when you slip.
- Two ways to learn: follow the specification in order, or switch to Real-World missions that start from a real problem and build the knowledge you need.
- Labs: an Electoral Systems Lab (see how the same votes become different seats under first past the post, list systems and AMS), a Bill Pathway Lab (UK Parliament against US Congress), and an Ideology Mapper.
- Essay plans, source practice with original extracts, and debate matchers for every unit.
- Timed mock sets matching each paper's topics.
- A Coverage screen that states exactly which boards and specifications are covered, and what is not.
- An optional Other boards map that shows where each unit sits in IB, AP and other A Level courses.
- Text size from 50% to 300% on every screen, and layouts that make full use of phones and tablets.

### Balanced and Current
Politics changes quickly. Lessons mark dated facts "as of" and were checked in November 2026. The app presents balanced accounts and does not take a political side.

### Important
Ballotwick is an independent study aid. It is not produced or endorsed by AQA, Pearson Edexcel or any examining body, and it does not replace your specification or teacher. Always check your board's current documents. No result is guaranteed.

Questions or corrections: support@equalinformation.com
monetization: Free core course, optional monthly Plus
